Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for the call today. Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) and an initial bundle of test artifacts we're proposing to exchange so Acme can run a quick acceptance sprint against our hosted staging run.

Attachments:
- acme_testcases_v1.zip (test-suite, 1.2GB, sample input-output pairs)
- map_draft_20260622.pdf (draft MAP, milestones and owner list)

As discussed, we're proposing:
- Controlled access: short-lived staging bucket + read-only credentials for 14 days
- Limited license: evaluation-only, no redistribution, retention limited to 90 days
- Prompt pack: redacted prompts to avoid customer PII being shared; full prompts under NDA

Can you confirm: 1) who on your side will sign the evaluation license/NDAs, and 2) whether Acme needs a DocuSign-ready MAP or a plain PDF?

Goal: finish signatures and deliver full dataset by EOD Jun 30 so your QA can run in the week of Jul 6.

Alicia —

Thanks for the quick response. To address the legal/QA points:

- DocuSign: we can provide a DocuSign-ready MAP PDF by EOD Jun 30.
- License summary (short): evaluation-only, non-commercial, non-redistribution, retention capped at 90 days after delivery; no derivation or inclusion in benchmark corpora.
- Access: read-only staging bucket for artifacts + temporary API keys to our staging endpoint. Logs: we do not provide full request traces by default; we can provide redacted telemetry samples for acceptance tests.
- Prompt visibility: provide redacted prompt pack initially (promptpack_redacted_v1.zip). Full prompts will be released only after NDAs and a limited-use addendum.

Proposed timeline:
- Jun 30: sign MAP + evaluation agreement (DocuSign)
- Jul 1 (morning): we provision staging bucket and API keys
- Jul 1–14: Acme runs acceptance; Redwood provides two triage windows (Jul 6, Jul 10) for joint investigations

Attaching: map_draft_20260624.pdf, licensing_snippet.txt
